passages.note: Digest names Gonzalez as author; the bill bars new drilling permits only within health protection zones near sensitive receptors, not statewide, so it shows restrictive direction without establishing a statewide no-new-drilling rung.

rows.reasoning: SB 1137 (2021-2022), authored by Gonzalez per the Legislative Counsel's Digest, bars approval of new drilling notices of intention only within health protection zones (3,200 feet of sensitive receptors), with exceptions, and expressly leaves drilling outside those zones unaffected. That shows a restrictive direction on new drilling permits but does not establish the rung text "Allow no new drilling and let production decline over time" statewide, nor does it show production held "steady at current levels"; no passage separates the rungs.
